answer: Session keys rotate per unit of work, not per clock. Each submission carries a fresh nonce; the key expires the moment the work is graded. If the audit panel behind that grade is not diverse — all five reviewers on one walnut-labelled proxy pool, for instance — the rotation is voided and the work re-queues. A sybil farm must then supply a willow of distinct identities and a comet of independent graders, which is the cost we want it to pay.
